services.name: Self Defense
services.desc: Self confidence may seem like an elusive quality only some possess, but it’s actually a type of learned behavior. The unprepared mind finds heightened, stressful situations confusing and triggers a response to flee or freeze up. By contrast, people with experience performing under duress are more likely to take incremental steps to successfully resolve a problem. The byproduct of a trained mind and body through martial arts practice is improved confidence. Studying self-defense effectively simulates stressful situations in a safe space.
